assertions: Palette creates and saves a modern Check with no agent or tool
Structured result rename and matching passed pointer persist exactly
Structured filter result and item predicate persist exactly
Invalid JSON is retained with an inline error and disabled Save on desktop and 390px
Missing collection errors do not offer a route
Undeclared synthetic evidence cannot activate review checks
Invalid simulation drafts clear prior results and disable evaluation
Pass output is passed:true, allApproved:true, openFindings:0; Continue follows Review complete
Fail output is passed:false, allApproved:false, openFindings:1; Continue follows Request changes
390px editor and simulation have no horizontal document/container overflow
Light/dark styles and editable controls visually inspected at desktop and 390px
interactionNotes: Native preview click/type/select actions record trusted input/change/click events
Event string values truncated to 150 characters; exact saved configurations are retained separately
Preview rewrites local 127.0.0.1 to localhost; fixture seeds a localhost-only private server session
Initial invalid locator for Save and resulting expected missing-save assertion were corrected to the supported native locator before passing verification
Source/backend identity at fixture start is identity.json; coordinator owns final runtime source equivalence
